name: Order Command Center
description: Local order desk: validate, score fraud and margin, then route quarantine, rejection, review, backorder, parcel, and pickup. Sample data only.

name: Revenue Reconciliation and Leak Audit
description: Match a local invoice book to payments, refunds, and chargebacks. Age the open items and separate leaks, collections, overpayments, and cleared cash.

name: Support Command Desk
description: Classify a local ticket queue by intent, sentiment, SLA risk, and legal language, then write an escalation, a priority packet, or an auto-reply.

name: Content Operations Factory
description: Turn a local brief list into a compliance hold, a revision, or an approved pack with a social cut, a newsletter cut, and a calendar slot.

name: Incident Command and Postmortem
description: Correlate a local alert stream into incidents, open a bridge for severity 1, draft a status note for customer-facing issues, and file internal noise.
